title: Delete account
intro: Deleting your account is permanent. Please read what happens before you continue.

consequences.heading: What happens when you delete your account
consequences.sessions: You'll be signed out everywhere and your login will stop working.
consequences.profile: Your name, email, phone and saved addresses are removed or anonymised.
consequences.retained: Past orders, invoices and payment records are kept where the law requires (accounting, tax, fraud and dispute handling) — they are no longer linked to you by name.
consequences.grace: We schedule the deletion after a {graceDays}-day grace period. You can cancel any time before then.
consequences.irreversible: Once the grace period ends, anonymisation cannot be undone.

password.label: Confirm your password
password.help: We ask for your password to make sure it's really you.

status.pending: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {date}. You can still cancel until then.
status.cancelled: Your account deletion request was cancelled. Your account stays active.
status.emailSent: We've emailed you a confirmation link. Open it to schedule your account deletion. The link expires in 1 hour.

noPassword.note: Your account has no password (you sign in with a code or a social login). Use the button below and we'll email you a confirmation link instead.

guestNote: Don't have an account, or can't sign in? To request deletion of your data, email us at {email}.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
